comparison.objective: Open a stiff quarter-turn valve using a loose tube as a cheater bar, rather than tune and lock a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tube-over-handle insertion and high-leverage quarter-turn force application versus recessed hex-key engagement, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and controlled setscrew torque.
comparison.success_condition: Valve opened after fitting the tube; body is empty and no spec versions or torque/damage rubric are available. Candidate requires iterative adjustment, two bounded cycles, and post-lock drift verification.
comparison.reason: Despite shared tool alignment and rotation, the valve task tests leverage to overcome resistance, not fine calibration and retained dynamic performance.
